public.riff-sign-in/v1/code: Asking for a code is what someone signed out does. Limited to three codes an email and ten an address in fifteen minutes (Codes::PER_EMAIL, Codes::PER_IP), a hundred times that only on a local site, and it answers the same whether or not the email has an account.
public.riff-sign-in/v1/code/verify: Typing the code in is how they sign in. Five tries a code, and a code lasts ten minutes (Codes::TRIES, Codes::TTL).
public.riff-sign-in/v1/assertion/options: A passkey's challenge, asked for before anyone is signed in. It is random, single use and lasts five minutes (Passkeys::TTL).
public.riff-sign-in/v1/assertion: Signing in with a passkey: the signature over that challenge is the proof.
